Class NavigationDecision

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.NavigationDecision
public final class NavigationDecision extends Object
An extension's verdict on a NavigationRequest: proceed, block, or proceed against a different URL. Created through the static factories.
